create_project: create a Label Studio project with a title, label config, and organization via the ProjectListAPI endpoint
list_projects: list user's Label Studio projects with pagination, filtering by title or ids, and optional field includes
validate_label_config: validate a Label Studio labeling configuration XML string and return whether essential data has changed
get_next_task: get the next unlabeled task for a user in a project with queue info and ML predictions if available
delete_all_tasks: delete all tasks from a specific project, reset project summary counters, and emit webhooks
